verdict.rationale: Decagon's AOPs let teams define agent behavior/escalation rules in natural language, and 'guardrails' are described as retained under technical team control, which could support marking certain topics as human-only; Watchtower can flag legal/compliance/sentiment topics for review. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'human-only topic' or hard-escalation feature, nor any evidence (hands-on or audit) confirming the agent never engages on flagged categories. Missing for 10: explicit human-only/topic-exclusion configuration feature, proof/testing that the agent reliably refuses or escalates on those topics, and independent verification of enforcement.
